description: Reviewed geocoding queries for properties where the plain address is ambiguous in London or missing. Each entry replaces the automatic queries with one more specific query (usually adding the postal district). Reviewed against the first geocoding run (see README). Entries with lat/lon are manual coordinates and replace geocoding.
